Inside, rolled tight, a note in faded ink: 'To whoever finds this — I am well. I married the girl from the mainland. Tell no one I still write to lighthouses.' Elias read it twice, laughed until his ribs ached, and set it on the sill beside forty others. Every keeper on this coast knew the tradition: messages came and messages stayed, because a lighthouse is where lost words come ashore. At dusk he lit the lamp, as always, and wondered which bottle the sea would send next.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市沉在墨蓝色的寂静里。路灯把湿漉漉的马路照成一条条光的河流，偶尔有出租车碾过水洼，溅起碎银般的反光。早点铺的灯最先亮起，蒸笼冒出第一缕白汽，混着雨后泥土的气息。高楼里零星几扇窗还醒着，像夜海中不肯熄灭的渔火。环卫工的扫帚声由远及近，又渐渐远去。天边泛起鱼肚白，第一班地铁在地下深处轰隆作响。城市尚未醒来，却已开始呼吸。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something does the same thing again, but a little smaller each time — like a story that keeps saying 'and then...'.\n- To stop it you need a base case: the smallest version where you already know the answer, like the tiniest doll in a nest of dolls.\n- To solve the big problem, you open one layer, let the same trick handle the rest, then put all the answers back together."}
